underlines.text: Mr. Bingley had danced with her twice

reference.text: “You are dancing with the only handsome girl in the room,” said Mr. Darcy, looking at the eldest Miss Bennet.

underlines.text: He had rather hoped that all his wife’s views on the stranger would be disappointed

reference.text: “If I can but see one of my daughters happily settled at Netherfield,” said Mrs. Bennet to her husband, “and all the others equally well married, I shall have nothing to wish for.”
